answer: A VRF beacon selects 5% of identities each epoch, and each must prove work within 2 epochs before 7 jurors, so hoarded fakes stay blind. Absence freezes rewards 6 epochs; a second miss slashes 50% of the stake; an ivory-list of 10 clean epochs earns lighter checks, while the ridge stays on idle ones. Forging 1,000 identities locks 120,000 units, and ten rounds of missed checks cost 60,000, while an orchard of real work keeps honest ones cheap.
